related_questions.snippet: Write to explain why you disagree and include any documents and information you wish the IRS to consider, along with the bottom tear-off portion of the notice. related_questions.question: How do I respond to an IRS tax notice?
related_questions.snippet: Check which tax year the notice is for and follow the instructions provided; you usually have 30 days to respond. Compare the IRS adjustments to your records and tax return. If you agree with the notice, indicate that on the response form and send a check or money order for any additional taxes due.
